name: AI proteomics: from protein identification to virtual cells
reality_check: published 28 July 2026. six areas where AI is moving MS proteomics: peptide/protein identification and quantification, protein-protein interactions and complexes, spatial and perturbation proteomics, multi-omics integration, and AI virtual cells. the operationally useful part is Supplementary Table 1 - a curated table of tools with model, model type, task, year and article link, which is close to this registry's schema and worth ingesting directly. note the framing: the paper's closing argument is a call for an "AI-friendly ecosystem" among data producers and consumers. that is a data-infrastructure argument, not a modelling one.

reality_check: the most important entry in this file for anyone doing imaging. name: spatial omics clinical status (placeholder row - track, do not adopt)

name: CellChat
model_type: mass-action law of communication probability + pattern recognition
reality_check: the most-used option. v2 adds spatial constraint; v1 is not spatially aware at all.

reality_check: not spatially aware by construction. treat spatial claims from it with suspicion.

model_type: collective optimal transport with spatial distance constraints
reality_check: genuinely spatial - transport cost encodes physical distance. the right default for spatial CCC.

model_type: consensus framework wrapping multiple LR methods
reality_check: the pragmatic answer to method disagreement - run several and take consensus. given the 2026 Genome Biology benchmark showing method performance varies by platform and metric, consensus is defensible where a single method is not.

name: HEST-1k / HEST-Benchmark / HEST-Library

training.corpus: 1229 paired ST + H&E samples, 2.1M expression-morphology pairs, 60M detected nuclei
training.tissues: 25 organs, 2 species, 320 cancer samples across 25 subtypes, 131 cohorts

reality_check: the reference benchmark, and its own authors flag the limits - ST data is inherently noisy and label noise is unavoidable. downstream papers add that HEST-1k is heterogeneous in acquisition technology, resolution, species (mouse-heavy) and therapeutic domain, so topping HEST does not imply transfer to your cohort. best correlations sit near 0.3 Pearson on top variable genes.

endorsements.source: Nature Communications 2025 multiscale spatial omics integration
endorsements.claim: introduced to address dataset-size limitations, but remains heterogeneous across technology, resolution and species

github.description: Integrating histology and spatial transcriptomics - NeurIPS 2024

name: iSTAR
model_type: hierarchical ViT feature extraction + expression prediction
reality_check: near-single-cell resolution inference from spot data. widely cited as the strongest of the pre-foundation-model generation.

literature.title: Methodology of peri-operative imaging data reporting for stone disease: a systematic review toward the development of a novel checklist-iSTAR.

name: sCellST
reality_check: matches patch-based methods at spot level while recovering finer cell populations. the point is that patch-based methods discard subcellular morphology by construction. Nat Commun Jan 2026.

literature.title: sCellST predicts single-cell gene expression from H& E images.

name: STFlow
reality_check: scalable whole-slide generation rather than per-spot regression. evaluated on HEST-1k with patient-stratified splits.

name: TRIPLEX
reality_check: CVPR 2024, multi-resolution context. a standard baseline in the 2025-2026 comparisons.

literature.title: RNA•DNA:DNA triplex formation by <i>HIF1α-AS1</i> modulates individual base pair stabilities in the <i>adrenomedullin</i> DNA target duplex.

name: Virchow2

training.tissues: pan-cancer, globally diverse institutions, mixed magnification, diverse stains

reality_check: top-tier but not uniformly. CLS+mean-of-patch-tokens embedding is required to reproduce reported numbers, not CLS alone. pretraining corpus is proprietary so benchmark contamination cannot be audited. licence blocks anything commercial.

endorsements.source: Nature Biomedical Engineering 2025, 19 FMs / 13 cohorts / 6818 patients
endorsements.claim: best vision-only model, significantly better than all others on 6-12 tasks; ties CONCH overall

endorsements.source: medRxiv/PMC 2025, 31 FMs across 41 tasks
endorsements.claim: highest mean performance on TCGA tasks (0.706 +/- 0.10); top-3 on CPTAC

endorsements.source: Bioengineering 2026 review
endorsements.claim: named top-tier alongside CONCH and H-Optimus-1

name: Virchow2G / Virchow2G-Mini
model_type: vision SSL (DINOv2), ViT-G, 1.9B params; Mini distilled to 22M
reality_check: Virchow2G-Mini at 22M params is competitive with 632M-1.1B models on HEST-Benchmark. if inference cost matters this is the interesting entry, not the giant.

endorsements.source: Virchow2 paper self-report
endorsements.claim: Virchow2G best average on HEST-Benchmark (0.350), ahead of H-optimus-0 (0.347)

name: UNI / UNI2
reality_check: UNI2 does NOT uniformly beat UNI - at least one 41-task benchmark has UNI ahead (0.70 vs 0.69). do not upgrade on version number. UNI is the most pretraining-token-efficient model tested.

endorsements.source: Nature Communications 2025 clinical benchmark
endorsements.claim: most efficient model per pretraining dataset size; best on lung NGS mutation tasks

name: CONCH / CONCHv1.5
reality_check: the quiet winner. far smaller than the giants yet matches Virchow2 overall and leads on prognostic tasks. lower embedding dimension also behaves better under ridge regression - the giants suffer curse-of-dimensionality on small-n spatial tasks.

endorsements.source: Nature Biomedical Engineering 2025
endorsements.claim: highest AUROC across 29 binary tasks; leads 7 prognostic tasks; on par with Virchow2 overall

endorsements.source: HEST-Benchmark
endorsements.claim: best ridge-regression result for gene expression prediction (0.316)

name: Prov-GigaPath
model_type: DINOv2 tile encoder (ViT-G) + LongNet slide aggregator (masked autoencoder)

training.tissues: 31 tissue types, Providence Health network, 28 US cancer centers

reality_check: excels on lung and pan-cancer - almost certainly because lung is over-represented in pretraining. this is the canonical worked example of why you read pretraining composition before trusting a leaderboard. real-world US cohort, so distribution is closer to clinic than TCGA-trained models.

endorsements.source: PMC 2025 41-task benchmark
endorsements.claim: highest performance on tumor type classification; top-3 on CPTAC

name: H-optimus-0 / H-optimus-1
model_type: vision SSL (DINOv2), ViT-G/14, 1.1B params, 4 register tokens
reality_check: consistently top-3 and no published pretraining description. zero reproducibility and zero contamination auditing possible. fine for a production embedding, weak for a paper where a reviewer asks about data leakage.

endorsements.source: Bioengineering 2026 review
endorsements.claim: named top-tier alongside Virchow2 and CONCH

name: Phikon / Phikon-v2
reality_check: the honest open baseline. TCGA-pretrained, which means it is contaminated with respect to TCGA benchmarks - use it on non-TCGA cohorts. underperforms the giants but the licence lets you actually ship.

github.description: Code associated to the publication: Scaling self-supervised learning for histopathology with masked image modeling, A. Filiot et al., MedRxiv (2023). We publicly release Phikon 🚀

name: TITAN
model_type: multimodal whole-slide VLM, built on CONCHv1.5 patch features (512px @ 20x)

training.tissues: neoplastic, infectious, inflammatory; BWH/MGH private + GTEx public

reality_check: published in Nature Medicine and genuinely strong, but 423k of its captions are machine-generated by PathChat. that is a provenance question nobody is asking loudly enough - a model trained on another model's output, evaluated by the same lab. precomputed TCGA features are a real time-saver.

github.description: Multimodal Whole Slide Foundation Model for Pathology - Nature Medicine

literature.title: Behind the mask: Hidden dangers of the operating room.

name: THREADS
reality_check: the interesting idea is supervising slide representations with molecular rather than text labels. preprint stage, no independent evaluation. watchlist, not adoption.

name: PRISM
model_type: multimodal slide-level model over Virchow tile features
reality_check: slide-encoder choice moves numbers more than patch-encoder choice. swap this against TITAN before committing.

name: CHIEF
reality_check: wrapped by TRIDENT, easy to A/B against TITAN and PRISM.

name: PathChat / PathChat DX
reality_check: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation - one of the first generative AI tools in pathology to get it. designation is NOT clearance and confers no diagnostic authority. also note PathChat generated the synthetic captions inside TITAN's training set.

name: Nicheformer

training.tissues: 73 human and mouse tissues, 17 organs, 18 cell lines

reality_check: genuinely useful trick - transfers spatial context onto dissociated scRNA-seq, so legacy single-cell archives gain neighbourhood information. but it uses gene expression ONLY and discards spatial coordinates, which several follow-ups call out explicitly.

endorsements.source: SToFM (ICML 2025)

name: scGPT-spatial
model_type: transformer with Mixture-of-Experts decoder, continual pretraining from scGPT
reality_check: the MoE-per-protocol decoder is the right architectural response to platform heterogeneity and is the part worth stealing even if you do not use the model. human-only.

endorsements.source: Advanced Science 2026 spatial omics guide
endorsements.claim: cited as the reference approach for cross-modal imputation of sparse spatial data

literature.title: scGPT-spatial: Continual Pretraining of Single-Cell Foundation Model for Spatial Transcriptomics

name: KRONOS
model_type: ViT-S/16 DINOv2 with channel-wise stem + sinusoidal marker-identity embeddings

training.corpus: SPM-47M - 47M single-marker patches from 3.67M multiplex patches
training.tissues: 16 tissue types (normal + malignant), 175 protein markers, 30 cohorts, 5 institutions

reality_check: panel-agnostic by construction - marker-identity embeddings mean it does not break when your antibody panel differs from the training panels. that solves the single biggest blocker to cross-study spatial proteomics. small model (ViT-S), cheap to run.

endorsements.source: Nat Methods 2026 AI proteomics Perspective (Sun et al.)
endorsements.claim: spatial proteomics named as one of six areas AI is actively reshaping, following Method of the Year 2024

model_type: graph neural network foundation model, self-supervised
reality_check: graph-native rather than sequence-native, so it actually uses coordinates. zero-shot niche assignment across slides is the selling point.
